image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle view of a staircase featuring a modern handrail. Two human arms are visible in the foreground, one on the left wearing a blue shirt sleeve and one on the right also in blue, both appearing to hold or rest near the handrail. The handrail is dark, possibly metal or dark wood, with a smooth, rounded profile. It runs diagonally upwards from left to right. Below the handrail, light-colored wooden steps are visible. In the background, out-of-focus green foliage (likely a palm or similar plant) and a building facade with windows can be seen. The lighting appears natural and bright.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture on the left arm appears overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking fine pores or wrinkles. The transition between the hand and the blue sleeve is slightly blurred and indistinct, suggesting possible fusion or generation artifact.

The fingers of the right hand appear to merge unnaturally with the handrail. The thumb and index finger lack clear definition and seem to melt into the rail surface rather than gripping it distinctly. Anatomical proportions of the hand look slightly distorted.

The edges of the wooden steps show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective lines, particularly where the step meets the vertical riser. This suggests minor geometric instability in the generated structure.

While some blur is expected for depth of field, the background elements exhibit an unnatural, smudged quality rather than optical bokeh, indicating possible AI-generated background synthesis artifacts.
